description: B baseline vs volume, flow persistence, momentum reweighting and gated variants

variant_rules.B_FLOW_PERSIST: Replace original 10 acceleration points with 5 state-gated acceleration + 5 buy-day persistence points
variant_rules.B_LESS_MOMENTUM: Reduce r5 and r10 weights by 5 points each; add up to 10 points for five buy days
variant_rules.B_COMBINED: Candle volume + flow persistence + reduced momentum
variant_rules.B_COMBINED_GATE: Combined; require complete five-day institutional fields, positive net flow, bullish trend, valid candle and price/volume factors; at most 20

notes: B/B1/B2 formulas unchanged; B3/B4 use same-date historical OHLC from data/daily_k
B4 uses signed foreign+trust+dealer from historical institutional records
Low candle coverage is exploratory only; missing candles retain B penalty, and gated universe differs
Reconstructed universe and same-close entry can introduce bias; costs excluded

next_open_test.method: Next trading session open to 5th/10th session close, fixed holding only
limitations: Incomplete daily_k coverage can bias unpaired summaries; inspect coverage
One-price sessions excluded, other execution capacity not verified
Overlapping signals are not independent trades or a portfolio equity curve
No out-of-sample claim; prospective signals must be frozen separately
Legacy summary uses same-close entry and no costs; never mix with next_open_test
